name: @niivue/nv-ext-tile
description: Tiled image formats for NiiVue's NVSlide: pyramidal TIFF/OME-TIFF/SVS by HTTP Range (/tiff) and DICOM-WSI folders and hosted manifests (/dicom)
comment:niivue-peer: A literal range, not workspace:* (which bun publish pins to the exact current rc), so one release accepts later niivue rcs and 1.x. devDependencies keeps workspace:* for local dev. The floor is the first niivue release with NVSlide.iccTransform (#583), which registerDcm2niixDecoders calls; raise it when this package needs a newer niivue API.
